sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' and /26 'Parking Lots' (https://gisblue.mdc.mo.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Discover_Nature/Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (autumn) 300 m frame around 39.7857,-94.8825 and a z19 tile mosaic, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Young riparian woods along 1.75 miles of Missouri River frontage west of St. Joseph. MDC's camping area is in the woods just southeast of the single gravel lot at the end of NW Dupree Road; no track to it shows on imagery, so a rig may have to stay at the lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. The site is now mapped: the 9/8/2026 area map draws a 'Camping Area' beside the lot and MDC GIS has a 'Primitive Camping Area' point 102 m SE of the lot (39.78536,-94.88211), under canopy with no visible track. Pin move to that point suggested; not waterfront confirmed.
flags: SITE LOCATED (stored note said MDC does not map it): the area map updated 9/8/2026 shows a 'Camping Area' symbol just SE of the parking lot at the end of NW Dupree Road, and MDC's Camping Sites layer now has a 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 39.78536,-94.88211, 102 m SE of the lot (39.78595,-94.88303, GIS Surface 'Paved', Allows_Trailers 'No'). On autumn imagery the lot is a small clearing (~30 x 25 m) at the road end, reached on a gravel road from NW 26th - a 23-ft rig reaches it; the camping point itself is under continuous canopy with no visible vehicle track from the lot, so it may be a walk-in spot and a rig would stay at the lot. No ford or posted limit.

PIN: suggest 39.78536,-94.88211 (MDC's camping point, 102 m SE of the stored lot pin), following the Apple Creek precedent; if AWH prefers the drivable spot, the stored lot pin 39.78595,-94.88303 is where a rig parks.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The camping point is ~60 m and the lot ~120 m from the Missouri River bank through continuous woods; no open apron or confirmable view.
Note rewritten: 'MDC does not map where the sites are' is now wrong (9/8/2026 map + GIS point); generic MDC text and directions dropped.
